body: My order BB-1040 arrived with a torn bag and I would like a refund.

sentences.text: I'm sorry that a bag from order BB-1040 arrived torn.
Send us a photo of the bag and the box within 14 days of delivery, and we will send a replacement.

sentences.problem: states a fact without citing a source

sources.title: Order BB-1040
sources.text: Order BB-1040: delivered. Dates: placed 2026-09-23, roasted 2026-09-25, shipped 2026-09-26, delivered 2026-09-29. Ships to CZ with Vltava Post, tracking number VP481920337CZ. Items: 2 x Basalt Blend, whole-bean, 250 g, at 289 CZK each. Delivery 89 CZK. Total 667 CZK.

sources.title: Damaged, stale or wrong items §1: Torn or crushed bags
sources.text: If a bag arrives torn, punctured or crushed, send us a photo of the bag and the outer box within 14 days of delivery. We send a replacement free of charge, and you don't need to return the damaged bag.
